analysis.analysis:
Positive-control capture, and the registry's first clean one of the week. Against the same-week provenance-inversion specimen (Negentropic Kernel Archive) and entity-collision specimen (Alexanarch/SoundCloud), this surface is substantially accurate: it identifies the artifact (Enli Lucente, Paper 194, 「構造心理における多層間通信」, manuscript original, sheet No. 1), dates it correctly (2026-07-19), reports the in-frame timestamp (2026年7月19日 8:54), attributes the documentation to the specification rather than to the cited scholar, and preserves the division of authority between apparatus author and external scholar that §H/§J.2/§P were written to hold. The specification's own coinage — in-frame attestation — is returned as a characteristic of the object rather than as one framework among several: the term is operating as the retrieval layer's descriptive vocabulary.

Recursion. The specification's subject is the conditions under which analog inscription becomes machine-eligible. This capture is the machine layer treating that inscription as eligible, four days after the edition of record and three days after countersigned approval. The doctrine's success condition and the capture are the same event.

Attribution anomaly, resolved. All three bullets carry the Academia.edu citation except 'Indexical Presence' — the author's physical shadow across the page read as direct physical trace (Peircean index) — whose citation bracket is empty. Full-text verification against the v1.0 HTML (data/attachments/AXN-0592/, 16,084 words) confirms the phrase is the specification's own: §F reads 'the maker's shadow, the body that wrote the page entering the capture as Peircean index, the “emanation of a real” Barthes named the photograph's truth (Camera Lucida, 1980)', with Peirce, C. S., 'On the indexical sign', Collected Papers, in the References. FINDING: this is attribution decay, not confabulation — the composition layer reproduced the source's most interpretively loaded formulation accurately and dropped the citation on precisely that unit. Sourced content and unsourced content are voiced identically, so the reader cannot distinguish the decayed unit from a synthesized one without holding the original.

Consent scope. Uses of the external scholar's name, words, corpus and materials in §H, §J.2, §P, References II and Figures 1–2 are covered by countersigned approval received 2026-07-22 against the exact bytes of PDF SHA-256 5ec0728eb9e1cc6f5abb9bbe4085e75a13f1455c40670b69b076a4b319d8945d. This capture records only the public retrieval surface of already-consented published material.

analysis.reading:
A HANDWRITTEN SHEET IS ADDRESSABLE IN THE COMPOSITION LAYER SIX DAYS AFTER IT WAS INDEXED. The manuscript carries an author’s research index date of 2026-07-19; this capture is 2026-07-25. Both cards resolve the query to the correct sheet, by number, inside a 52-page specification, and reproduce the Japanese title 「構造心理における多層間通信」 with its corner brackets intact.

That is what EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 exists to establish: that an analog artifact can be made machine-eligible without being converted into born-digital text. The mechanism appears in the snippet — "photographed with IN-FRAME ATTESTATION" — and the answer offers to "detail the DATED-WITNESS PROTOCOL used for these analog inscriptions."

FIGURE-LEVEL GRANULARITY IS THE FINDING. Every other archive citation in this registry resolves to a work; this one resolves to FIGURE 1, SHEET 1 of a named person’s paper. The addressable unit is smaller than a deposit.
